chunks: They said: "We swear by God. You know we did not come to commit any crime in the land, nor are we thieves."
ai.seo_question: What did Joseph's brothers say to their father to explain his disappearance?
ai.summary: In this verse, the brothers of Prophet Joseph (AS) address their father Jacob (AS), swearing by Allah to assert that they did not intend to cause corruption in the land nor were they thieves who stole Joseph. This declaration serves to reassure Jacob of their integrity and clarify that the disappearance was not due to a malicious act of theft by the brothers themselves, but rather than an external abduction.
